data: What is the maximum value of the BLEU score for the green line in the rightmost graph?

The green line represents the BLEUVar-10 estimator. In the rightmost graph (b), which corresponds to 50 samples, the green line reaches its peak at approximately 60 on the y-axis. Therefore, the maximum value of the BLEU score for the green line in the rightmost graph is around 60.
